To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have proved the equivalence of the following: 1) fuzzy finite state automaton (FFA) with fuzzy recurrent neural network (FRNN); and 2) deterministic finite state automaton with recurrent neural network.
fuzzy systems and models are equivalent to recurrent neural networks.
the following knowledge equivalence representations can be proved: (a) deterministic finite state automaton (DFA) to recurrent neural network (RNN); (b) fuzzy finite state automaton to RNN.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the representation of knowledge in terms of finite state automata, recurrent networks, and fuzzy systems.
the synthesis and implementation of knowledge representation systems that combine the power of fuzzy and neural systems.
the synthesis of recurrent neural networks from finite state automata, and in particular, fuzzy finite state automaton models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method provides a means to synthesize fuzzy automata as recurrent neural networks and to map them into VLSI systems.
fuzzy finite state automaton can be represented by recurrent neural network and vice versa.
fuzzy automata can be represented in a neural network, and that the dynamics of a fuzzy automaton is stable in a recurrent neural network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fuzzy finite state automaton can be synthesized into recurrent neural networks, which can then be directly implemented as a very large scale integration system.
fuzzy finite state automaton can be synthesized by a recurrent neural network with fuzzy parameters and the resulting network is stable for finite values of weights.
fuzzy finite state automaton (FFA) can be represented by recurrent neural network (RNN) and the RNN is equivalent to fuzzy dynamical systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fuzzy finite state automaton can be mapped into recurrent neural network, and vice versa, in an equivalence-preserving way.
fuzzy finite state automaton can be represented as a recurrent neural network.

fuzzy finite state machines (FFSM) can be directly implemented in recurrent neural networks, thus allowing for a direct implementation in VLSI, and the FFSM can be represented as an equivalence to DFA.
